title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper RedSan: A Redundant Memory Instruction Sanitizer for GPU Programs
problem: Artifact evaluation for SC25 reproducibility report on GPU memory instruction sanitization.
motivation: SC25 Reproducibility Initiative assessment of RedSan artifact.
method: The team obtained the RedSan tool, which uses redundant checking to catch problematic memory instructions in GPU programs. They ran this tool on the test cases from the original paper and followed SC25's standard procedures to verify the results matched the original findings.
key_novelty: This work confirms that RedSan's method for detecting memory instruction problems in GPU programs is reproducible and reliable.
